summary: This note is the documentation page for the OctomapServerContact node in the jsk_pcl_ros package of the JSK jsk_recognition project. The node builds an occupancy grid map that includes a contact sensor model, deriving from the OctomapServer class. It documents the node's subscribed and published topics, advertised services, configurable parameters, and sample launch commands for simulation and real sensors.
one_line: Documentation for the OctomapServerContact node, an occupancy grid mapper with a contact sensor model derived from OctomapServer.
key_facts: OctomapServerContact is an occupancy grid map in which the contact sensor model is available.
The OctomapServerContact class is derived from the OctomapServer class.
The node subscribes to contact_sensors_in of type jsk_recognition_msgs::ContactSensorArray for input contact sensor data.
The node subscribes to cloud_in (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2) for the input pointcloud and proximity_in (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2) for input from proximity sensors.
The node publishes octomap_full and octomap_binary as octomap_msgs/Octomap messages.
The projected_map topic (nav_msgs/OccupancyGrid) is a downprojected 2D occupancy map; since octomap_mapping 0.4.4 it is named projected_map by default to avoid collisions with static 2D maps.
The self_see_default_padding parameter defaults to 0.001 and self_see_default_scale defaults to 1.0, both matching pr2_navigation_self_filter.
The frame_id parameter defaults to /map, and base_frame_id defaults to base_footprint.
The resolution parameter defaults to 0.05 meters for an empty starting map.
The sensor_model/max_range parameter defaults to -1 (unlimited); a limit such as 5m is suggested to prevent spurious far-away points.
The sensor_model hit and miss probabilities default to 0.7 and 0.4; the min and max clamping probabilities default to 0.12 and 0.97.
The filter_ground parameter defaults to false and uses pcl::SACMODEL_PERPENDICULAR_PLANE to detect the ground plane.
The ground_filter distance defaults to 0.04, angle defaults to 0.15, and plane_distance defaults to 0.07.
The simulation sample is launched with sample_octomap_server_contact_pr2.launch.
For real sensors, the depth sensor is launched via openni.launch and then octomap_server_contact.launch is run; sample_octomap_contact.launch demonstrates frontier grids.
